name: Multilinear Differential Operator Embedding
description: Replaces an exact-cover subset-sum condition (usually implemented with superincreasing sequences or bitmasks) with an equivalent differential algebra property. Each candidate set becomes a mixed partial derivative operator, and the target is a multilinear monomial. The composition of operators applied to the monomial yields 1 if and only if the variables are partitioned perfectly (an exact cover), because any overlap results in differentiating a linear term twice, yielding 0. This forces models to deduce combinatorial properties from calculus mechanics, defeating surface-level pattern matching.
